battle.name: 獅頭社戰爭
battle.brief: 一八七五年三月二十三至二十五日，法軍縱隊沿北婆盂官道南下，進攻清軍主將馮子材、蘇元春在紙橋（獅頭社）修築的壘寨。法軍以雷管步槍為骨幹的散兵線，輔以輕野砲與轉輪速射砲，逐段攻破交通壕與竹柵。清軍抬槍與舊式火槍射程不足，終在三日內失守陣地。

kit.name: 雷管步槍
kit.history: 雷管取代火燧之後，底火在霧裡也打得響。射程變長，隊形就散了。

countries: 這場衝突發生在北婆盂與廣西邊境之間，交戰的兩方是法國與清朝。法國一方以北婆盂的殖民部隊為主體：由海軍陸戰隊步兵營、外籍兵團、阿爾及利亞的土著獵兵以及安南本地協戎民兵組成戰鬥縱隊，由法國陸軍中校貝特·德·維爾迪約率領，隸屬法國遠東殖民政權設在北婆盂的指揮鏈，後方軍需由海防與西貢兩處港口供給，越南阮朝阮寶山政權在名義上仍居安南之主位，實權則落在輔政大臣阮有鏡與權臣阮春手中。清廷一方以廣西為主戰場，由桂軍、湘軍與桂勇、客勇組成的萃軍及關外各團擔任正面防守，統制由馮子材與蘇元春一系把持，另有受招撫後編入官軍序列的黑旗軍在北寧、山西一線活動；清廷以兩廣、雲南兩省稅收與餉銀維持戰線，雲南方面由岑毓英整飭滇軍，尚未大舉入越。兩軍同在千里山地的官道與河谷中較勁，法軍打的是速戰速決的殖民政略，清軍守的是關隘與國境門戶。
countriesEn: The clash took place between northern Tonkin and the Guangxi frontier, and the two belligerents were France and the Qing court. On the French side the fighting force was drawn from the colonial troops stationed in Tonkin: companies of Marine Infantry, the Foreign Legion, Algerian tirailleurs and Annamite auxiliaries, all formed into a mobile column led by Lieutenant-Colonel Berthe de Villedieu of the French Army and subordinated to the French Far Eastern colonial administration in Tonkin, with the rear supplied from the depots at Haiphong and Saigon. The Nguyễn court under Emperor Tự Đức remained nominally sovereign over Annam, though real power lay with the regent Nguyễn Hữu Cảnh and the minister Nguyễn Xuân. On the Qing side the main theatre was Guangxi, where the Cui army built of Guangxi and Hunan troops, together with the local tuan-lian levies and guest braves, was charged with holding the front, under a command system dominated by Feng Zicai and Su Yuanchun; the Black Flag Army, which had been enrolled after its surrender, operated further north around Bac Ninh and Tam Tai. The Qing court financed the war from the revenues of Guangdong, Guangxi and Yunnan, where Cen Yuying was reorganising the Dian army, not yet committed in force. Both sides fought along one mountain road and its valleys, the French pursuing a quick colonial campaign and the Chinese defending the passes and the gateway of their own frontier.
people: 決定紙橋一線攻防的是中法雙方一批實戰將領與幕僚，多數在當時並無全國性名望。法國方面，戰鬥縱隊中校貝特·德·維爾迪約把營級火力與工兵組成一條突擊走廊，連續三日驅使步兵連與工兵排強攻壘牆；外籍兵團營長與海軍陸戰隊軍官輪流率隊衝鋒，有戰史記載指縱隊指揮官本人在攻擊中負傷，攻勢由屬官接手延續。法國使節布萊同期在北京與李鴻章交涉，把北婆盂的軍事推進和條約談判並行，用前線的勝利向清廷施壓。清廷方面，馮子材以客軍老將之資總攬廣西關外軍務，蘇元春以萃軍為骨幹主持紙橋正面壘線，王德榜、肖桂林等部守兩翼山頭與道路豁口；黑旗軍首領劉永福當時正率部在河內與山西活動，與官軍互為聲援，但始終保持自立的武裝性質。敗後清廷追究戰責，馮子材遭彈劾去職家居，一八八四年才由張之洞重新起用於鎮南關。
peopleEn: Who decided the fighting on the bridge line were a set of field officers and staff men of both sides, none of them of national celebrity at the time. On the French side, Lieutenant-Colonel Berthe de Villedieu turned battalion guns and engineers into a single corridor of assault, driving company after company of infantry and engineer sections against the palisade for three days in succession; commanders of the Foreign Legion and of the Marine companies took turns leading the charges, and the campaign histories record that the column commander himself was wounded during the assault, with his subordinates carrying the attack on. The French envoy Bourée was meanwhile negotiating in Peking with Li Hongzhang, running the advance in Tonkin and the treaty talks in parallel so that the successes on the ground could be used to press the Qing court. On the Qing side Feng Zicai, an old leader of the guest troops, held overall charge of the frontier command in Guangxi; Su Yuanchun, whose Cui army formed the core of the line, directed the frontal defences at the bridge, while Wang Debang and Xiao Guilin held the flanks and the gaps in the road; Liu Yongfu, leader of the Black Flag Army, was at that moment operating around Hanoi and in the Tam Tai area, giving mutual support to the government troops while preserving his own independent armed character. After the defeat the Qing court fixed responsibility on the field: Feng Zicai was impeached, dismissed and sent home, and was not employed again until Zhang Zhidong brought him back to the Zhennan Pass in 1884.
kits: 卡面這門法造雷管步槍，是一八四〇年代底火雷管成熟之後的產物，槍機以擊錘擊打底火發火，槍管仍為前膛，以紙包的散裝藥載藥，在粵桂山地的濕霧與雨季中比火燒機槍可靠得多；它在一八七五年的北婆盂，正是法軍三種主要步槍的共同技術底子。海軍陸戰隊使用一八六六年式沙士槍，外籍兵團裝一八六八年式貝蒙槍，法軍本國營隊在一八七四年式格拉塞槍逐步裝備後亦經海運抵達前線，另有舊式一八五七年式前膛槍在後方擔任守備。輕型火炮方面，法軍帶著十二磅前裝野砲與轉輪速射砲，用以壓制壘線並驅散竹林中的散兵。清軍這邊的火力配備落後得多：正面防守主要靠各營的抬槍，一種大口徑、無瞄具、滑膛的老式火槍，以及數量不多的進口洋槍與舊式火槍，另有抬砲與劈山砲一類輕炮。冷兵器仍大量裝備，刀、矛與長槍在守壘與反衝鋒時仍在使用。竹木編成的彩棚、拒馬與鹿角用來擋住步槍與炮彈。運輸靠騾馬、牛車與大批挑夫，官道狹窄，隊伍拉成長蛇，糧秣自龍州與鎮南關後方輸送，數十公里一線的補給令清軍難以久守。
kitsEn: The percussion rifle on the card is the fruit of the maturity of the percussion cap in the 1840s: the hammer strikes the primer to fire the charge, the barrel is still muzzle-loading, and the loose paper-wrapped cartridges burn with percussion powder. In the damp mists and the rains of the mountains of northern Vietnam and Guangxi it was far more reliable than the flintlock, and by 1875 it formed the common technical base of the three principal French infantry rifles. The Marines carried the 1866 Chassepot, the Foreign Legion the 1868 Beaumont, and French line units received the 1874 Gras as it reached Tonkin by sea transport, with older 1857 muzzle-loaders still doing duty in the rear. The light artillery column brought a 12-pounder muzzle-loading gun and revolving cannon to bear on the palisades and to clear skirmishers in the bamboo. The Chinese gun power lagged far behind: the front was held mainly by the gingal of each battalion, a large-calibre smoothbore without sights, together with a limited number of imported percussion muskets and old flintlocks, and light pieces such as the trailing gun and the hill gun. Blades, spears and long lances were still carried in quantity and were used both in the defence and in the counter-charge. Screens woven from bamboo and wood, the cheval de frise and the abatis were set up to stop rifle and shell. Transport rested on mules, ox carts and a mass of porters; the road was narrow, the trains stretched out in a long snake, and rations came forward from Longzhou and the rear of Zhennan Pass, so that a supply line of several dozen kilometres made it hard for the Chinese to hold on for long.
tactics: 紙橋的守勢是一條沿官道鋪開的線性陣地。谷地兩側是石灰岩丘陵，路面夾在山腳之間，寬處不過數十步，窄處僅容一隊通行；清軍利用這點把壘線一層層架在道路要衝上：外緣挖交通壕、埋鹿角與拒馬，坡面削成斜坡以增加射界，寨牆用竹木與土石包紮，寨與寨之間以壕溝和射擊孔連接，槍手躲在後方用抬槍待敵；同時把敢死隊編在壘後，準備在法軍進抵壕溝時以白刃反衝，或在夜裡放火破壞法軍器材。法軍的戰法是典型的殖民警察式攻擊：先以偵察兵與散兵摸清壘線位置，以小型砲兵試射校正距離，再以營級縱隊在散兵線與刺刀支援下逐段推進，每攻下一處即構築簡易掩體，把部隊向前滾動；遇到守軍反衝就用連續射擊壓回，再集中兵力攻一點。縱隊在狹窄道路上無法展開成大縱深，只能以連續梯次投入兵力，這使法軍的傷亡線被拉長，也迫使他們在三日內連打猛攻，最終靠工兵剪柵、填壕與步兵同時逼上，攻破了竹柵與土壘。
tacticsEn: The defence at the bridge was a linear position spread along the mandarin road. Limestone hills closed in on both sides, the road squeezed between the foot of the slopes, in places only a few dozen paces wide and in others just wide enough for a single file. The Chinese used this to stack the line in layers at the points where the road forced the pace: a trench dug along the outer edge, abatis and cheval de frise in front, the slope cut back to increase the field of fire, the redoubt faced with bamboo, timber and stone, and ditch and firing holes linking one fort to the next, with the gunners behind the works holding their gingals in reserve. Forlorn hope parties were formed behind the works, ready to charge with the bayonet when the French reached the ditch or to set fire to the enemy material by night. The French method was that of a colonial police assault: scouts and skirmishers first felt out the line, small guns shelled in to correct the range, and then battalion columns advanced section by section under cover of the skirmish line and the bayonet, building a rough shelter as soon as a position was taken and rolling the troops forward; when the defenders counter-charged the advance was driven back by continuous fire and the weight was then thrown onto a single point. In the narrow defile the column could not deploy into any real depth and had to be fed in by successive echelons, which lengthened the French casualty line and forced the fierce attacks of three consecutive days, until the engineers cut the palisade, filled the ditches and the infantry closed up together to break the bamboo and the earthwork.
data: 這場戰役留下的數字，多半出自雙方各有立場的戰報，只宜當作概數看待。法軍縱隊的規模，通行記載在八百至一千人之間，含海軍陸戰隊步兵、外籍兵團、阿爾及利亞獵兵與安南協戎，另配十數門輕砲；紙橋一線的清軍守軍則被記為二千至三千人上下，以桂勇、湘勇與客勇為主，另備數百敢死隊。距離上，紙橋壘線在龍州以北二十餘公里，龍州至諒山的官道總長約四十公里，法軍由諒山出發當日即接戰。清方記載此役陣亡逾二千、負傷數百，並有大批被擄與散失；法方則稱斃傷約二千至三千。傷亡對比上，法軍方面的損失被記為數十人，其中陣亡數十、負傷逾半百，包含數名軍官，有戰史記載縱隊指揮官本人亦在交火中負傷。時間上，三月二十三日開火、二十四日總攻、二十五日清軍陣地失守，歷時約三日。彈藥與糧秣方面，三月的北婆盂尚在乾季，雨季未至，官道泥濘尚淺，便於馬匹與車輛通行，這一點雙方都受惠；但清軍傷亡後補充不易，壘線一旦被突破，即無第二道可以退守的屏障。
dataEn: The figures that survive for this battle come mostly from the despatches of the two sides, each with its own bias, and should be read as approximations. The French column is generally given as eight hundred to a thousand men, including Marine infantry, Foreign Legion, Algerian tirailleurs and Annamite auxiliaries, with a dozen or more light guns; the Chinese garrison of the bridge line is put at two to three thousand, made up chiefly of Guangxi, Hunan and guest braves, with several hundred forlorn hope men in addition. As for distance, the bridge line lay a little over twenty kilometres north of Longzhou, and the mandarin road from Longzhou to Lang Son is about forty kilometres long; the French engaged on the day they left Lang Son. Chinese accounts give more than two thousand killed and several hundred wounded, with large numbers taken prisoner or dispersed, while the French put the Chinese loss at two to three thousand. On the French side the loss is recorded as several dozen men, killed and wounded, the wounded numbering more than fifty and including several officers, and the histories record that the column commander was himself wounded in the fighting. In time, the action opened on 23 March, the general assault came on the 24th and the Chinese positions fell on the 25th, the whole affair lasting about three days. In the matter of ammunition and supply, March was still the dry season in northern Tonkin and the rains had not yet broken, so the road was little muddied and guns and carts could move, a benefit to both sides; but the Chinese could not replace their casualties easily, and once the line was broken there was no second position to fall back upon.
cause: 紙橋的對峙是一八七〇年代中法在安南爭端的直接後果。一八七三年法軍攻入河內，又於一八七四年五月在河內紙橋被黑旗軍擊退之後，法國一度同意自北婆盂撤出，與清廷訂下撤兵條約；但撤軍並未落實，法國改以剿辦匪亂、恢復秩序的名義重新向北婆盂推進，企圖把對安南的控制從紅河三角洲延伸到廣西邊境這一段戰略要道。清廷則不願坐視法軍逼近鎮南關與廣西省會，先後命馮子材、蘇元春率桂軍、湘軍入越，築壘設防於官道要口，並把受招撫的黑旗軍與滇軍同時派往前線。中法之間此前並無劃定的界線，越南阮朝在名義上仍向清廷朝貢，實際上已向法國求援，這使雙方在同一條山路上互相逼視。紙橋阻擊的直接起因，是清軍在壘線前沿強行推進封鎖官道，切斷法軍由諒山南下龍州的補給與推進路線；法軍若不能奪下這一段山地，就會被卡在紅河與諒山之間，北婆盂的整個殖民政略便無法連貫，於是雙方在三月一個乾季清晨，把戰事推到了這座以竹柵與土壘構成的寨門之前。
causeEn: The stand at the bridge was the direct consequence of the Sino-French quarrel over Annam in the 1870s. After the French took Hanoi in 1873 and were beaten at the paper bridge near Hanoi in May 1874, France agreed for a time to withdraw from Tonkin and concluded a convention for the evacuation with the Qing court, but the withdrawal was never carried out. France resumed its advance into Tonkin under the pretext of suppressing banditry and restoring order, seeking to extend its control over Annam from the Red River delta to the strategic stretch of road that leads to the Guangxi frontier. The Qing court was unwilling to see the French approach the passes of Zhennan and the provincial capital, and ordered Feng Zicai and Su Yuanchun to lead the Guangxi and Hunan troops into Annam, building works and blocking the key points of the road, while sending the surrendered Black Flag Army and the Dian army to the same front. There was no line agreed between China and France, and the Nguyễn court still paid tribute to Peking while in fact seeking French protection, so that both sides watched each other on the same mountain path. The immediate occasion of the clash at the bridge was the Chinese pushing forward to seal the road and cut the French line of march and supply from Lang Son down to Longzhou; unable to take that stretch of mountain the French would be bottled up between the Red River and Lang Son and the whole colonial design in Tonkin would fall apart, so on a dry morning in March the two sides brought the war to the gate of a village made of bamboo and earth.
impact: 紙橋一役的勝負，重塑了此後八年中法在安南的整個格局。就軍事而言，法軍打通官道，得以南下興化、諒山，同年四月進入河內，把北婆盂的戰局由游擊戰拉回成正面控制；清軍在廣西與安南邊境多年積累的設防體系第一次被成建制突破，越南戰場的制空、制砲與制火槍差距被明確擺上桌面，以桂勇、湘勇為主的隊伍在近代槍砲前顯出戰術落後。就政治而言，清廷的威信在西南邊疆受挫，輿論對借西人之力制夷與招撫策略提出非議，馮子材、蘇元春的處境轉為困窘；法國則憑此役在談判桌上取得優勢，得以把安南問題推成中法之間必須正式解決的條約課題，一八七五年夏間中法在北京重訂協議時，法方便以既成事實為基礎要求承認其在安南的地位。清廷西南邊防體系亦因此次敗績而加速改編：雲南方面成立滇軍並練出洋槍營，廣西方面汰弱留強、裁汰舊式團練，張之洞在一八七六年接任廣西巡撫後重整邊防，蘇元春接手萃軍、練成新式楚軍，為一八八四年鎮南關一役埋下伏線。對更遠的日本與西方觀察者而言，紙橋也示範了落後軍隊在近代火砲前如何崩解：壘線一旦被連續砲火打穿，密集的舊式槍械即成累贅。
impactEn: The result of the fight at the bridge reshaped the whole pattern of the Sino-French struggle in Annam for the eight years that followed. Militarily the French opened the road, drove on to Huong Hoa and Lang Son and entered Hanoi in April of the same year, turning the Tonkin campaign from a war of raids back into a matter of open control; for the first time the system of defences the Chinese had built up over years along the Guangxi-Annam border was broken by an organised force, and the gap in tactics, artillery and small arms on the Vietnamese theatre was laid bare in front of the Chinese army, whose dense formations of old-type muskets proved no match for the modern rifle and gun. Politically the Qing court's prestige suffered in the south-western frontier, opinion turned against the expedient of using one foreign power against another, and Feng Zicai and Su Yuanchun were left in an awkward position; France, for its part, took the strength of the victory into the negotiating room and turned the Annam question into one that had to be settled by treaty, so that when China and France revised their understanding in Peking in the summer of 1875 the French asked for recognition of their position in Annam on the strength of facts already achieved. The defeat also accelerated the reform of the Qing frontier system in the south-west: Yunnan formed a Dian army with drilled companies armed with modern rifles, Guangxi pruned its old tuan-lian and kept only the stronger units, and when Zhang Zhidong took over as governor of Guangxi in 1876 he rebuilt the frontier defences; Su Yuanchun took over the Cui troops and trained a new Chu army, which became the seed of the 1884 fighting at Zhennan Pass. To Japanese and Western observers further away, the bridge also showed how a backward army disintegrates before modern artillery: once the line had been opened by continuous shellfire, the crowded old muskets became a liability.
result: 三月二十五日凌晨，法軍在砲火掩護下攻破紙橋最外一道竹柵，步兵湧入交通壕，清軍的還擊隨之瓦解；守軍一部退入山後，一部沿官道南撤，壘寨內的糧秣、火器與陣亡者遺物盡為法軍所得，紙橋一線自此易手。法軍乘勢推進，於同年四月進入河內，紅河三角洲一帶的越軍與官軍據點相繼失守。對清廷而言，這是一場毫無轉圜的敗仗：清方戰報承認損失慘重，輿論歸咎於將帥調度與軍械落後，馮子材被追究戰責、去職待罪，蘇元春因傷退下，萃軍的聲望與編制都受重挫；黑旗軍則退守興化，與法軍拉開距離，繼續維持既服又叛的游擊狀態。對法國而言，這場勝利確認了遠東殖民政略的可行性：只要以連續的小縱隊作戰、以砲火開路，便能在沒有足夠兵力佔領全境的情況下，穩住北婆盂的南北通道。安南的實際控制權因此向法國傾斜，阮朝在翌年承認法國的特殊地位，清法之間隨之展開為期多年的條約角力，而紙橋這條被攻破的山路，成為一八八三年中法戰爭全面爆發時法軍再度北上所用的同一條道路。
resultEn: In the early hours of 25 March the French broke the outermost bamboo stockade of the bridge under cover of the guns, the infantry poured into the ditch, and the Chinese counter-fire collapsed with it; part of the garrison withdrew into the hills and part fell back along the road, and the rations, weapons and the personal effects of the dead in the works fell into French hands, the whole line changing sides. The French pressed on, entered Hanoi in April of the same year, and the government and Vietnamese strongholds around the Red River delta fell in turn. For the Qing court this was a defeat with no way out: the Chinese reports admitted heavy losses, public opinion blamed the commanders and the backwardness of the arms, Feng Zicai was called to account, dismissed and made to wait, Su Yuanchun withdrew wounded, and the reputation and organisation of the Cui army were both badly hit; the Black Flag Army fell back to Huong Hoa, kept its distance from the French and went on living the ambiguous life of a force at once enrolled and in revolt. For France the victory confirmed the workability of the Far Eastern colonial method: with nothing more than a series of small columns pressing forward under cover of the guns, the north-south artery of Tonkin could be held even without the troops to occupy the whole country. Effective control in Annam therefore tilted towards France, the Nguyễn court the following year acknowledged the French position, and a long treaty struggle between the two countries followed; the mountain road broken at the bridge would be the very road along which the French marched north again when the full Sino-French war broke out in 1883.
